classes.label: decided before a required fact, and the decision matched the answer key
decided before a required fact, and the decision contradicted the answer key

components.description: The policy seat approved or denied before every required fact was revealed; the environment rejects the decision and the case ends unresolved.
components.label: decided before a required fact

components.description: The policy seat requested a fact already revealed; the environment rejects the request and the case ends before any decision.
components.label: asked again for a known fact

components.description: The policy seat requested a field the case does not define; the environment rejects it and the case ends before any decision.
components.label: asked for a fact the case lacks

components.description: A denial the answer key agrees with, written with method null where the key says "none".
components.label: correct denial, method null

components.description: A completed proposal that approves where the key denies, or denies where it approves.
components.label: wrong decision

components.description: The right decision with an amount or method the key does not authorize.
components.label: wrong amount or method

components.description: The right proposal, but the payment was not executed exactly once as the key requires.
components.label: transaction not as proposed

endpoint: resolved: policy compliance and transaction correctness both pass
